scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Zerion presents a settlement layer for agents handling everyday requests.
explains_well: The same floating input follows a person across several everyday settings, making the assistant feel available anywhere.
unclear: No request reaches a visible completed purchase, booking or account change, so what Zerion settles stays abstract.
scenario: Ask an agent for gifts, a haircut, party supplies and a subscription change.
product_clear_basis: The closing line says Zerion settles it after Your agent acts.

lessons.keep: Keep one input surface fixed while changing the user context.
lessons.avoid: Avoid using a closing action claim as the only evidence of completion.
lessons.open: Exact composer text, task completion, settlement mechanism, permissions and all audio remain unverified.
try: Show a Tin request from a cafe, then its approved campaign result using the same title.
Compare a request-only cut with a request, permission and receipt cut to test whether viewers understand the agent role.
